A collection of themed outfits for your farmer, each sets have two
variation of outfits of skirts and shorts. For best results the
outfits should be worn together to complete the set ^^. 

Hats and accesories can be worn with any outfits.

Animated pieces:
Fox tail - always animated
Racoon tail- animated when moving
Frog - idle animated

Adds 16 shirts, 8 skirts, 8 shorts, 16 hats and 3 accessories to the
fashion sense menu, they work best as a set to create
16 different cute outfits.

The sleeves are from peach female body and peach male body
but you can use any sleeve mod you like.
